sites.coordinate_method: Arithmetic mean of mapped OSM way vertices from fresh XML, approximate crossing-area marker (not survey centroid): way/1443180803

sites.evidence_note: Fresh OSM preserves named Resuo/Rasuwagadhi Friendship Bridge geometry with start_date 2019 and destroyed/end_date 2025 tags. This is the historical road bridge for 2020–22 phases, not derelict pedestrian suspension bridge or 2026 replacement.
